item.title: Keep Pushing: We Get 10 More Days to Reform Section 702
item.description:
📝 Take action TELL congress: 702 Needs Reform Section 702 is rife with problems, loopholes, and compliance issues that need fixing. What’s more, victims of this surveillance won’t even know and have very few ways of finding out that their communications have been surveilled. Take action TELL congress: 702 Needs Reform.
🔗 Read more: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/04/keep-pushing-we-get-10-more-days-reform-section-702
